subject: Trial Gateplaybook: Week 2 checkpoint & sprint owners
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@olivetech.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Trial Gateplaybook: Week 2 checkpoint & sprint owners

Hi Sara / Tom —

Thanks again for kicking off the trial last week. Attached is the Week 2 slice of the Gateplaybook (OLV_MAP_v2.xlsx) plus the latest acceptance criteria doc (eval-acceptance-criteria.pdf). Quick summary of current status and owners: 

- Milestone: Inference endpoint + sample traffic (owner: sean_gallagher) — target: 11/12
- Milestone: Logging + audit schema (owner: rishi_malhotra) — target: 11/13
- Milestone: Eval plan (metrics + test prompts) (owner: marissa_cole) — target: 11/16
- Acceptance snapshot: baseline latency <= 180ms P95, top-10 prompt fidelity within 5% of baseline model (see attached criteria)

Blockers called out in the map: 
- Infra access for private endpoints (customer IT task)
- Centralized logging format (we need a sample log schema)

Asks before our checkpoint meeting: 
1) Sara/Tom — can you grant the connector role for the test VPC by EOD Thursday (11/11)?
2) Marissa/Rishi — please populate the \"test cases\" tab in the workbook with owners by Wednesday (11/11) noon.

Proposed checkpoint: Friday 11/13 at 10:00am PT — 30 minutes to review progress and escalate any persistent blockers. If that works, I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: OLV_MAP_v2.xlsx (workbook), eval-acceptance-criteria.pdf, infrastructure-checklist.xlsx

Thanks — Sean
Sean Gallagher
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@olivetech.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@olivetech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial Gateplaybook: Week 2 checkpoint & sprint owners

Thanks Sean — quick update from our side: 

- Infra: IT has scheduled the VPC connector change but needs a service account from Redwood (can you provide details?).
- Logging: our platform currently logs trace_id, user_id, and raw_request — we don't capture token-level timing yet.
- Eval plan: we reviewed the acceptance doc. Two asks: can we relax latency to 200ms P95 for the first 48 hours of the trial while traffic warms? Also, we want an explicit fidelity check for the 8 enterprise prompts in Tab C.

Blockers: the service account + a sample log payload are the two things holding up our devs.

Happy to meet Friday; 10:00am PT works.

Thanks — Sara
Sara Klein
Head of Platform Engineering | OliveTech

On Mon, Nov 09, 2026 at 09:12 AM Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai> wrote:
> (original message attached)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Klein <sara.klein@olivetech.com>, Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial Gateplaybook: Week 2 checkpoint & sprint owners

Sara — appreciate the quick read. Answers and actions below: 

- Service account: created. Attached is the service-account.json stub and instructions in the infra workbook (infrastructure-checklist.xlsx). Tom — we'll need the target service account email to be whitelisted by your IT team; copying the pattern in the checklist.
- Latency: we can accept 200ms P95 as a temporary warm-up tolerance for the first 48 hours. I'll note that in the acceptance doc and add a timestamped rollback to 180ms after the warm-up window.
- Fidelity checks: Marissa will add the 8 enterprise prompts to Tab C and mark the scoring thresholds.

Owners & actions: 
- sean_gallagher: provision canary endpoint + baseline runs (ETA: 11/12 EOD) — action: create canary config in the workbook
- rishi_malhotra: provide sample log payload and mapping (ETA: 11/12 noon) — action: update infra workbook
- marissa_cole: finalize eval cases + scoring rubric (ETA: 11/16)
- Sara/Tom: whitelist service account + confirm VPC connector (ETA: 11/11 EOD)

I'll send the calendar invite for Friday 11/13 10am PT and include a shared checklist in Drive.

Sean

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Sara Klein <sara.klein@olivetech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial Gateplaybook: Week 2 checkpoint & sprint owners

Looping in a commercial note — I see a redline in the PO we received around token usage caps during trial. Can someone confirm whether OliveTech wants the trial to run under a hard cap or to allow burst-with-reporting? If it's a hard cap, procurement will need the final expected token volumes by Monday (11/16) to issue the temporary trial PO.

Also: I will add the 8 enterprise prompts to the eval workbook today. If OliveTech expects a canary with quantized weights, flag that in the workbook so we can pick the correct variant for baseline runs.

-Marissa
Director, Product GTM | Redwood Inference

From: Sara Klein <sara.klein@olivetech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Ruiz <tom.ruiz@olivetech.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 14 Nov 2026 16:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Trial Gateplaybook: Week 2 checkpoint & sprint owners

Thanks team — confirmed: IT will whitelist the service account by EOD Monday (11/16) due to an internal change freeze earlier in the week. We can tolerate the 200ms warm-up window.

On the canary: we do want a quantized canary variant for the first baseline run to validate cost/latency tradeoffs. Please include the variant ID in the workbook and call it out in the checkpoint deck.

See you on the Friday checkpoint — Sara
